OCHA/Pacific Community ADM2 layer `vut_admbnda_adm2_spc_20180824` contains 66 area-council polygons; REST metadata says source PopGIS2/Pacific Community, published 2018-08-24, created 2017-10-31. Its metadata fields for license and copyright are blank. We used only its layer description/count as neighboring-tier context, not its geometry.
